problem_statement: The OpenThread operational dataset API does not provide a way to compare two datasets for equality. A user needs to determine whether two operational datasets, in their TLV-encoded form, contain the exact same set of TLVs — same types and same values — regardless of the order in which the TLVs appear, and to correctly report a difference when one dataset has a TLV the other lacks or when the same TLV type holds different values (including for TLV types the comparison does not specially recognize).
